notes: Adds editable Safety access to the shared Inventory/Energy People directory. Admin can choose Give Safety access for a shared user with Safety OFF, select Safety role/working view and explicitly tick only the Safety site(s) required. No site is assigned automatically. Existing Safety accounts have Edit access for role, enable/disable, home site and site assignments. Username-only accounts support Admin temporary-password reset. New-site creator-only access and v2.11.47 targeted incident/document review remain in force. Backend shared-to-Safety account link table is already applied.
